entities.name: PMID:25082616
observations: Prospective cohort study examining subsequent injury after concussion in elite male football players; 46 teams in 10 European countries, seasons 2001/02–2011/12.

entities.name: Adjusted subsequent-injury hazard HR 1.47
observations: In elite male football players, concussion was associated with higher subsequent-injury hazard during the first year versus other injuries after adjustment for prior-year injury count (HR 1.47, 95% CI 1.05–2.05).
